items.t: VTi CVT transmission slips or fails
items.job: Replace CVT with a remanufactured or used unit
items.note: Owners report $3,500-$4,400 on average. The class action claim period has long closed.

items.t: 6-speed automatic loses 3rd, 5th and Reverse
items.job: Replace 3-5-Reverse wave plate (transmission overhaul)
items.note: Owners report about $3,400 on average. Ask a dealer whether GM special coverage still applies.

items.t: V6 5-speed automatic slips or shifts harshly
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with remanufactured unit
items.note: A fluid change may help if done early; owners report about $4,200 for full repairs.

items.t: 4-speed automatic hesitates, slips or fails
items.job: Rebuild or replace 4-speed automatic

items.t: Timing chain stretch
items.job: Replace timing chains, guides and tensioners
items.note: Labor is high because many parts must come off to reach the chains.

items.t: Timing chain rattle and tensioner failure
items.job: Replace timing chain, guides and tensioner

items.t: Electric power steering loses assist or feels jerky
items.job: Replace steering column motor assembly or control module
items.note: Used or rebuilt columns cost less than new.

items.t: Power steering cuts out or binds
items.job: Replace power steering pump or steering rack

items.t: Power steering line can leak onto exhaust (recall)
items.job: Inspect and tighten power steering line nut (recall 08V-470)

items.t: Front wheel bearing hum or grinding
items.job: Replace front wheel hub and bearing assembly (one side)
items.note: Owners report $300-$1,400 depending on whether one or both sides were done.

items.t: All lights flash and electrical glitches at start-up
items.job: Diagnose and replace body control module or engine computer
items.note: Owners report about $1,700 on average; a battery test first is cheap.

items.t: Key can come out when not in Off (recall)
items.job: Replace ignition lock cylinder and keys (recall 14V-490)

items.t: Key gets stuck in the ignition
items.job: Replace ignition lock cylinder or switch

items.t: Engine cuts out while driving
items.job: Replace crankshaft position sensor

items.t: Raw fuel smell from cracked fuel pump fittings
items.job: Replace fuel pump module and fuel line connectors

items.t: Airbag warning light on
items.job: Diagnose airbag system; replace sensor, module or wiring

items.t: Outside door handle can keep door from latching (recall)
items.job: Replace outside door handles (recall 09V-233)

items.t: Wrong steering knuckle can make a wheel turn out (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace steering knuckles (recall 08V-616)

items.t: Manual clutch hydraulic leak
items.job: Replace clutch master and slave cylinders and bleed
items.note: Owners report about $1,600 when the slave cylinder inside the bell housing is replaced.

items.t: Seat belt anchor bolts may be wrong (recall)
items.job: Replace seat belt anchor bolts (recall 01V-386)

items.t: Tire label lists the wrong wheel size (recall)
items.job: Corrected tire label (recall 03V-519)

items.t: Check engine light from loose or worn gas cap
items.job: Replace gas cap

items.t: Hybrid system shuts down from battery sensor or fan fault
items.job: Replace hybrid battery temperature sensor or cooling fan
items.note: Dealer price for a battery temperature sensor is about $114; hybrid diagnosis time adds cost.

items.t: Hybrid battery pack can leak internally (recall)
items.job: Hybrid battery repair or replacement (recall)

items.t: Serpentine belt and tensioner wear quickly
items.job: Replace serpentine belt and tensioner
items.note: The tensioner needs a special tool, so a dealer or hybrid-savvy shop is best.
